summary: FCB Financial Holdings is a regional bank concentrated in Florida. Its financial supply chain relies on deposits and wholesale funding for lending, with key fragility in Florida real estate exposure and interest rate sensitivity.

inputs.fragility: Medium - subject to competition and rate sensitivity
